$comment: Accepted per-slide mismatch thresholds, keyed by deck/notebook/slide. Populated as slides are fixed and signed off in Phase 4; the acceptance test suite (Phase 5) asserts new-stack renders stay at or below these. Empty until the fix loop begins.
metric: pixelmatch mismatch ratio (0=identical, 1=fully different). Note: dominated by white background, so use for RANKING worst slides, not as an absolute similarity score.
